summary: Issue a parking ticket when a vehicle enters
user_story: As a driver, I want a parking ticket at the entry gate so that my entry time is recorded.
description: Create an OPEN ticket containing a unique ticket ID, normalized vehicle number, and server-generated entry time. Reject entry when the lot is full.
acceptance_criteria: Every accepted entry creates exactly one unique OPEN ticket.
The occupied-space count increases exactly once.
No ticket is issued when occupancy equals configured capacity.
Repeating an entry request with the same idempotency key returns the existing ticket.
